impact_scope.description: S1 adds a new public CRC64 ECMA hasher and caller-facing operations for supplying byte slices, updating state, and reading a 64-bit checksum.
Exercising the new CRC64 entry points requires compiling/enabling the CRC64 module, while H0 explicitly enables only AUX BASE, AUX JSON, BASE, and JSON.

evidence: In S0, std/crc64/common_crc64.wuffs does not exist and the selected S0 context has no matching declaration.
Therefore S0 has no CRC64 ECMA public entry point, input buffer, hasher state, or module-enablement obligation for H0 to expose or control.

gap_after.type: unexercised new public API and module
evidence: S1 introduces public ecma_hasher operations, including update!(x: roslice base.u8), update_u64!(x: roslice base.u8), and checksum_u64().

H0 is exclusively a JSON decoder harness: it initializes wuffs_json__decoder and calls JSON decoding APIs, never constructs an ecma_hasher, supplies CRC64 input, performs updates, or reads its checksum.
H0's module configuration lists BASE and JSON modules but no CRC64 module, so the new CRC64 implementation is not enabled by this harness.

new_harness_obligation.description: A harness must enable the CRC64 module, construct an ecma_hasher, pass caller-controlled byte slices to update! or update_u64!, and observe checksum_u64; incremental calls would also expose the new persistent hasher state.
evidence: The entire CRC64 source file and its public ecma_hasher API are new in S1.
The new update entry points require a caller-supplied roslice base.u8 and mutate this.state.
H0 had no reason in S0 to enable CRC64 or perform these calls because the module and declarations were absent.

reason: Using the identical scope of the newly introduced CRC64 ECMA public API, S0 has no gap because the scope does not exist, whereas S1 has a material exposure and controllability gap because unchanged H0 neither enables nor calls it. This creates concrete compile-time enablement, construction, input-supply, and state-observation obligations, so the truth-table result is NEW and maintenance is needed.
